verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.pt: Disse o Senhor a Moisés e a Arão:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

verses.en: Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own standard, with the ensign of their father’s house: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Israel acampar-se-ão, cada um junto ao seu estandarte, com as insígnias das casas de seus pais; ao redor, de frente para a tenda da revelação, se acamparão.
verses.en_web: “The children of Israel shall encamp every man by his own standard, with the banners of their fathers’ houses: at a distance from the Tent of Meeting shall they encamp around it.”
verses.en_bbe: The children of Israel are to put up their tents in the order of their families, by the flags of their fathers' houses, facing the Tent of meeting on every side.

verses.en: And on the east side toward the rising of the sun shall they of the standard of the camp of Judah pitch throughout their armies: and Nahshon the son of Amminadab shall be captain of the children of Judah.
verses.pt: Ao lado oriental se acamparão os do estandarte do arraial de Judá, segundo os seus exércitos; e Nasom, filho de Aminadabe, será o príncipe dos filhos de Judá.
verses.en_web: Those who encamp on the east side toward the sunrise shall be of the standard of the camp of Judah, according to their divisions: and the prince of the children of Judah shall be Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.en_bbe: Those whose tents are on the east side, looking to the dawn, will be round the flag of the children of Judah, with Nahshon, the son of Amminadab, as their chief.

verses.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.
verses.pt: E o seu exército, os que foram contados deles, era de setenta e quatro mil e seiscentos.
verses.en_web: His division, and those who were counted of them, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.
verses.en_bbe: The number of his army was seventy-four thousand, six hundred.

verses.en: And those that do pitch next unto him shall be the tribe of Issachar: and Nethaneel the son of Zuar shall be captain of the children of Issachar.
verses.pt: Junto a eles se acamparão os da tribo de Issacar; e Netanel, filho de Zuar, será o príncipe dos filhos de Issacar.
verses.en_web: Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar: and the prince of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel the son of Zuar.
verses.en_bbe: And nearest to him will be the tribe of Issachar, with Nethanel, the son of Zuar, as their chief.

verses.en: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.
verses.pt: E o seu exército, os que foram contados deles, era de cinqüenta e quatro mil e quatrocentos.
verses.en_web: His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.
verses.en_bbe: The number of his army was fifty-four thousand, four hundred.

verses.en: Then the tribe of Zebulun: and Eliab the son of Helon shall be captain of the children of Zebulun.
verses.pt: Depois a tribo de Zebulom; e Eliabe, filho de Helom, será o príncipe dos filhos de Zebulom.
verses.en_web: The tribe of Zebulun: and the prince of the children of Zebulun shall be Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.en_bbe: After him, the tribe of Zebulun, with Eliab, the son of Helon, as their chief.

verses.en: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.
verses.pt: E o seu exército, os que foram contados deles, era de cinqüenta e sete mil e quatrocentos.
verses.en_web: His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
verses.en_bbe: The number of his army was fifty-seven thousand, four hundred.

verses.en: All that were numbered in the camp of Judah were an hundred thousand and fourscore thousand and six thousand and four hundred, throughout their armies. These shall first set forth.
verses.pt: Todos os que foram contados do arraial de Judá eram cento e oitenta e seis mil e quatrocentos, segundo os seus exércitos. Esses marcharão primeiro.
verses.en_web: All who were counted of the camp of Judah were one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out first.
verses.en_bbe: The number of all the armies of Judah was a hundred and eighty-six thousand, four hundred. They go forward first.

verses.en: On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their armies: and the captain of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.pt: O estandarte do arraial de Rúben segundo os seus exércitos, estará para a banda do sul; e Elizur, filho de Sedeur, será o príncipe dos filhos de Rúben.
verses.en_web: “On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.en_bbe: On the south side is the flag of the children of Reuben, in the order of their armies, with Elizur, the son of Shedeur, as their chief.

verses.en: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.
verses.pt: E o seu exército, os que foram contados deles, era de quarenta e seis mil e quinhentos.
verses.en_web: His division, and those who were counted of it, were forty-six thousand five hundred.
verses.en_bbe: The number of his army was forty-six thousand, five hundred.

verses.en: And those which pitch by him shall be the tribe of Simeon: and the captain of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.pt: Junto a ele se acamparão os da tribo de Simeão; e Selumiel, filho de Zurisadai, será o príncipe dos filhos de Simeão.
verses.en_web: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Simeon. The prince of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.en_bbe: And nearest to him, the tribe of Simeon, with Shelumiel, the son of Zurishaddai, as their chief.

verses.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.
verses.pt: E o seu exército, os que foram contados deles, era de cinqüenta e nove mil e trezentos.
verses.en_web: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
verses.en_bbe: The number of his army was fifty-nine thousand, three hundred.

verses.en: Then the tribe of Gad: and the captain of the sons of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
verses.pt: Depois a tribo de Gade; e Eliasafe, filho de Reuel, será o príncipe dos filhos de Gade.
verses.en_web: “The tribe of Gad: and the prince of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
verses.en_bbe: Then the tribe of Gad, with Eliasaph, son of Reuel, as their chief.

verses.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and five thousand and six hundred and fifty.
verses.pt: E o seu exército, os que foram contados deles, era de quarenta e cinco mil seiscentos e cinqüenta.
verses.en_web: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
verses.en_bbe: The number of his army was forty-five thousand, six hundred and fifty.

verses.en: All that were numbered in the camp of Reuben were an hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty, throughout their armies. And they shall set forth in the second rank.
verses.pt: Todos os que foram contados do arraial de Rúben eram cento e cinqüenta e um mil quatrocentos e cinqüenta, segundo os seus exércitos. Esses marcharão em segundo lugar.
verses.en_web: “All who were counted of the camp of Reuben were one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty, according to their armies. They shall set out second.
verses.en_bbe: The number of all the armies of Reuben together came to a hundred and fifty-one thousand, four hundred and fifty. They go forward second.

verses.en: Then the tabernacle of the congregation shall set forward with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camp: as they encamp, so shall they set forward, every man in his place by their standards.
verses.pt: Então partirá a tenda da revelação com o arraial dos levitas no meio dos arraiais; como se acamparem, assim marcharão, cada um no seu lugar, segundo os seus estandartes.
verses.en_web: “Then the Tent of Meeting shall set out, with the camp of the Levites in the middle of the camps. As they encamp, so shall they set out, every man in his place, by their standards.
verses.en_bbe: Then the Tent of meeting is to go forward, with the tents of the Levites, in the middle of the armies; in the same order as their tents are placed, they are to go forward, every man under his flag.

verses.en: On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their armies: and the captain of the sons of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.
verses.pt: Para a banda do ocidente estará o estandarte do arraial de Efraim, segundo os seus exércitos; e Elisama, filho de Amiúde, será o príncipe dos filhos de Efraim.
verses.en_web: “On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their divisions: and the prince of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.
verses.en_bbe: On the west side will be the flag of the children of Ephraim, with Elishama, the son of Ammihud, as their chief.

verses.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty thousand and five hundred.
verses.pt: E o seu exército, os que foram contados deles, era de quarenta mil e quinhentos.
verses.en_web: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty thousand five hundred.
verses.en_bbe: The number of his army was forty thousand, five hundred.

verses.en: And by him shall be the tribe of Manasseh: and the captain of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.pt: Junto a eles estará a tribo de Manassés; e Gamaliel, filho de Pedazur, será o príncipe dos filhos de Manassés.
verses.en_web: “Next to him shall be the tribe of Manasseh: and the prince of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.en_bbe: And by him the tribe of Manasseh with Gamaliel, the son of Pedahzur, as their chief.

verses.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
verses.pt: E o seu exército, os que foram contados deles, era de trinta e dois mil e duzentos.
verses.en_web: His division, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.
verses.en_bbe: The number of his army was thirty-two thousand, two hundred.

verses.en: Then the tribe of Benjamin: and the captain of the sons of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.pt: Depois a tribo de Benjamim; e Abidã, filho de Gideôni, será o príncipe dos filhos de Benjamim.
verses.en_web: “The tribe of Benjamin: and the prince of the children of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.en_bbe: Then the tribe of Benjamin, with Abidan, the son of Gideoni, as their chief.

verses.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
verses.pt: E o seu exército, os que foram contados deles, era de trinta e cinco mil e quatrocentos.
verses.en_web: His army, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.
verses.en_bbe: The number of his army was thirty-five thousand, four hundred.

verses.en: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were an hundred thousand and eight thousand and an hundred, throughout their armies. And they shall go forward in the third rank.
verses.pt: Todos os que foram contados o arraial de Efraim eram cento e oito mil e cem, segundo os seus exércitos. Esses marcharão em terceiro lugar.
verses.en_web: “All who were counted of the camp of Ephraim were one hundred eight thousand one hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out third.
verses.en_bbe: The number of all the armies of Ephraim was a hundred and eight thousand, one hundred. They go forward third.

verses.en: The standard of the camp of Dan shall be on the north side by their armies: and the captain of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.pt: Para a banda do norte estará o estandarte do arraial de Dã, segundo os seus exércitos; e Aiezer, filho de Amisadai, será o príncipe dos filhos de Dã.
verses.en_web: “On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan according to their divisions: and the prince of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.en_bbe: On the north side will be the flag of the children of Dan, with Ahiezer, the son of Ammishaddai, as their chief.

verses.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
verses.pt: E o seu exército, os que foram contados deles, era de sessenta e dois mil e setecentos.
verses.en_web: His division, and those who were counted of them, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
verses.en_bbe: The number of his army was sixty-two thousand, seven hundred.

verses.en: And those that encamp by him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the captain of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.pt: Junto a eles se acamparão os da tribo de Aser; e Pagiel, filho de Ocrã, será o príncipe dos filhos de Aser.
verses.en_web: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the prince of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ochran.
verses.en_bbe: Nearest to him will be the tribe of Asher, with Pagiel, the son of Ochran, as their chief.

verses.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
verses.pt: E o seu exército, os que foram contados deles, era de quarenta e um mil e quinhentos.
verses.en_web: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-one thousand and five hundred.
verses.en_bbe: The number of his army was forty-one thousand, five hundred;

verses.en: Then the tribe of Naphtali: and the captain of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.pt: Depois a tribo de Naftali; e Airá, filho de Enã, será o príncipe dos filhos de Naftali.
verses.en_web: “The tribe of Naphtali: and the prince of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.en_bbe: Then the tribe of Naphtali, with Ahira, the son of Enan, as their chief.

verses.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
verses.pt: E o seu exército, os que foram contados deles, era de cinqüenta e três mil e quatrocentos.
verses.en_web: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.
verses.en_bbe: The number of his army was fifty-three thousand, four hundred.

verses.en: All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan were an hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall go hindmost with their standards.
verses.pt: Todos os que foram contados do arraial de Dã eram cento e cinqüenta e sete mil e seiscentos. Esses marcharão em último lugar, segundo os seus estandartes.
verses.en_web: “All who were counted of the camp of Dan were one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They shall set out last by their standards.”
verses.en_bbe: The number of all the armies in the tents of Dan was a hundred and fifty-seven thousand, six hundred. They will go forward last, by their flags.

verses.en: These are those which were numbered of the children of Israel by the house of their fathers: all those that were numbered of the camps throughout their hosts were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
verses.pt: São esses os que foram contados dos filhos de Israel, segundo as casas de seus pais; todos os que foram contados dos arraiais segundo os seus exércitos, eram seiscentos e três mil quinhentos e cinquenta.
verses.en_web: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses. All who were counted of the camps according to their armies were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
verses.en_bbe: These are all who were numbered of the children of Israel, in the order of their fathers' families: all the armies in their tents together came to six hundred and three thousand, five hundred and fifty.

verses.en: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.pt: Os levicampo consagrado; a possessão dele será do sacerdote. foram contados entre os filhos de Israel.
verses.en_web: But the Levites were not counted among the children of Israel; as Yahweh commanded Moses.
verses.en_bbe: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel, as the Lord said to Moses.

verses.en: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses: so they pitched by their standards, and so they set forward, every one after their families, according to the house of their fathers.
verses.pt: Assim fizeram os filhos de Israel, conforme tudo o que o Senhor ordenara a Moisés; acamparam-se segundo os seus estandartes, e marcharam, cada qual segundo as suas familias, segundo as casas de seus pais.
verses.en_web: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so they encamped by their standards, and so they set out, everyone by their families, according to their fathers’ houses.
verses.en_bbe: So the children of Israel did as the Lord said to Moses, so they put up their tents by their flags, and they went forward in the same order, by their families, and by their fathers' houses.
